value.rationale: Three protected habitat cores with independently failing intermediate patches and a one-corridor conservation choice form a natural robust-connectivity model. Sharp n=8 switching boundary and golden-ratio threshold establish a mathematically nontrivial finite obstruction to uniformly optimal corridor choice, beyond average single-path scoring, and can serve as exact design benchmark without empirical overclaim.
